# Kuperberg, 2003 and 2007

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(pangoling)

setwd("experiment1")
```

```{r}
subtlex <- read_excel(file.path("data", "Subtlex-US.xlsx")) |>
    rename(
        "target" = "Word",
        "zipf_freq" = "Zipf-value"
    ) |>
    select(target, zipf_freq)

stim <- read_excel(file.path("data", "Kuperberg", "sentences.xlsx")) |>
    left_join(subtlex) |>
    mutate(wl = nchar(target)) |>
    filter(!is.na(target))
```

## Inspect stimuli
Word length
```{r}
stim |>
    select(wl) |>
    summary()

stim |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_density(aes(x = wl), fill = "aliceblue", alpha = .5) +
    labs(title = "Word length") +
    theme_minimal()
```

Word frequency
```{r}
stim |>
    select(zipf_freq) |>
    summary()

stim |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_density(aes(x = zipf_freq), fill = "aliceblue", alpha = .5) +
    labs(title = "Zipf frequency") +
    theme_minimal()
```

Log-probability
```{r}
# get lp
causal_preload("gpt2")

stim <- stim |>
    mutate(lp = causal_targets_pred(
        contexts = context,
        targets = target,
        model = "gpt2",
        batch_size = 10
    ))
```

```{r}
stim |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_density(aes(x = lp), fill = "aliceblue", alpha = .5) +
    labs(title = "lp") +
    theme_minimal()

stim |>
    mutate(cond = as.factor(cond)) |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_density(aes(x = lp, fill = cond, group = cond), alpha = .5) +
    labs(title = "lp") +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
stim |>
    group_by(cond) |>
    summarize(
        mean_lp = mean(lp),
        sd_lp = sd(lp)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = cond)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = mean_lp)) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(
            ymin = (mean_lp - sd_lp),
            ymax = (mean_lp + sd_lp)
        ),
        width = 0.2
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

ggsave("figs/lp_kuperberg.png")
```

```{r}
stim |>
    select(context, target, lp, cond) |>
    print(n = 8)
```
